_about: Disc list, one entry per Disc.id (131). Ids were established by template-matching card art against the APK thumbnails (scripts/match_disc_cards.py) from the user's screenshots and the Discord #resources previews, then cross-checked against the Appliv disc table (https://games.app-liv.jp/archives/450371): its icons were matched the same way and its Lv.10 stats agree with every card. 'effect' is the EN client text (or a translation of 'effect_jp' for the 22 N discs, which have no EN card); 'lv1'/'lv10' and 'coefficient_appliv' come from Appliv; atk/hp/coolTime = Lv.10. 'attribute' from the card frame colour (N discs: from the name/icon). 'typeToSkillActionType' maps the card type to Skill.skillActionType.
